name: Generic D3D12 game
notes: No game-specific settings: the layer's defaults (Apple GPU identity, feature level 12_0, shader model 6.6).
If the game refuses to start because of the GPU, try the 'AMD' or 'NVIDIA' GPU identity in the game's settings.
If the game needs AVX2 (most modern 64-bit titles do), launch it through the CLI or app: they set ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1.
